pipeline.title: AbbVie-backed ADARx plans IPO to bankroll array of clinical-stage siRNA therapies
pipeline.summary: ADARx has reinvigorated its ambitions to go public as the AbbVie-backed biotech looks to fund ongoing clinical trials of a range of next-gen small interfering RNA medicines.

pipeline.title: Novartis, Ionis drug failure spurs questions about an emerging class of heart medicines
pipeline.summary: Pelacarsen didn’t protect heart health despite lowering levels of a protein particle, “Lp(a),” in a large clinical trial — a surprise result with important implications for cardiovascular drug research.

pipeline.title: Ionis’ rare neurology drug approved; Pfizer inks an ADC deal
pipeline.summary: Zanvastro is now the first approved medicine for Alexander disease. Elsewhere, an immune system specialist posted positive results and a cell therapy developer turned to layoffs.

pipeline.title: AbbVie’s bispecific T-cell engager shows promise in ph. 3 multiple myeloma trial
pipeline.summary: AbbVie released positive phase 3 data Thursday showing that its bispecific T-cell engager etentamig improved response rates and progression-free survival in patients with relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx fails phase 3 Angelman test, plots ‘significant expense reductions’
pipeline.summary: Ultragenyx had been flying high after its recent FDA approval for Genglycos—but the company has been brought back down to earth with a damaging phase 3 flop.

pipeline.title: Fortrea boosts early-phase CRO platform with $45M acquisition of Worldwide division
pipeline.summary: Fortrea has agreed to acquire the early-phase services division of fellow CRO Worldwide Clinical Trials for $45 million.

pipeline.title: Novartis claims MS win as Rhapsido clears phase 3 with ‘no liver safety signal’
pipeline.summary: Novartis appears to have broken the curse of the BTK inhibitor class. The Swiss pharma announced Tuesday that two phase 3 trials for Rhapsido in relapsing multiple sclerosis hit their goals without any liver safety flags.

pipeline.title: ESC: Alnylam's next-gen silencer sees silver linings after fallout of AZ, Ionis trial in ATTR-CM
pipeline.summary: As AstraZeneca appears to close the book on a combo approach following the phase 3 failure of its Ionis-partnered Wainua, several analysts contend it’s too early to count out Alnylam’s silencing drugs in ATTR-CM patients also taking standard-of-care stabilizers.

pipeline.title: Novartis Lp(a) drug fails to lower cardiovascular risk in closely watched ph. 3 trial
pipeline.summary: Novartis’ Ionis-partnered drug designed to lower levels of Lp(a), a known cardiovascular risk factor, failed to reduce patients’ risk of a heart attack, stroke, or other major cardiovascular event in the first late-stage test for a drug meant to tackle the mysterious molecule.

pipeline.title: AZ leans on AI-generated llama to promote LAMA combo inhaler Breztri in new campaign
pipeline.summary: The Breztri ad prompts viewers to "put a LAMA to work" by depicting an AI-generated llama and his barnyard colleagues working a late night in the office.

pipeline.title: Trailing rivals, AbbVie scores win with dual-acting myeloma drug
pipeline.summary: The drugmaker is leaning on a better side effect profile compared to drugs from J&J, Pfizer and Regeneron as it pushes etentamig toward FDA submission.

pipeline.title: This week in charts: China deals, stock flatlines and Lilly’s M&A spree
pipeline.summary: Deals with Chinese drugmakers are continuing at a steady pace, while two mid-cap biotechs' stock prices took a tumble this week. Meanwhile, Lilly has outpaced other pharmas in dealmaking this year.

pipeline.title: Ionis’ ‘breakthrough’ Alexander disease approval establishes pillar of rare disease pipeline
pipeline.summary: After Jenny Pearson’s daughter Elise first had a seizure at 16 months old, an MRI came back clean—her brain “looked beautiful,” Pearson recalled to Fierce. But a follow-up scan a year later, just days before Thanksgiving, showed her frontal lobe was now awash in white splotches.

pipeline.title: Daiichi unit American Regent recalls 3 epinephrine batches on particulate, leakage concerns
pipeline.summary: Daiichi Sankyo subsidiary American Regent is launching a recall of three lots of generic epinephrine as it becomes one of the latest manufacturers to face headaches over particulate contamination in its drug products.

pipeline.title: Menarini signs $771M deal to take Gan & Lee GLP-1 to European market
pipeline.summary: Italian company the Menarini Group has agreed to pay Chinese insulin maker Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals €62 million ($72 million) up front to collaborate on the registration and commercialization of Gan & Lee’s GLP-1 bofanglutide.

pipeline.title: The people who stayed with the problem
pipeline.summary: In this week’s episode of “The Top Line,” we look at the people who kept working the problem, from scientists pushing past long-standing limits in cancer and protein design to physicians and public health leaders tackling trust, misinformation, vaccine policy and representation i

pipeline.title: UCB’s Bimzelx comes from out of the blue to claim August’s top pharma ad spending spot
pipeline.summary: Move over AbbVie and Johnson & Johnson, we have a new and surprising leading drug in the pharma ad spending space.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Roche, GSK, Novartis billion-dollar deals; More MFN sign-ups; Akeso’s OS win
pipeline.summary: GSK, Roche and Novartis continued their dealmaking spree with Asian companies. Three midsized Asian biopharmas reached MFN deals with the White House. Akeso and Summit's ivonescimab delivered a head-to-head overall survival win against Keytruda. And more.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Invivyd's chairman adds CEO role ahead of COVID readout
pipeline.summary: Infectious-disease biotech Invivyd has appointed its current chairman, Marc Elia, as CEO.

pipeline.title: Fresenius unit dinged in FDA warning letter flagging 'complaint trend' from customers
pipeline.summary: Following a string of customer complaints, a Form 483 and a recall this past spring, a Fresenius manufacturing unit in Utah is contending with a warning letter from the FDA.

pipeline.title: Novartis puts MS advocacy on the podium through social media partnership with British Olympian
pipeline.summary: The social media collaboration ties into Novartis' "you know your MS best" messaging, which encourages patients to keep track of changes in their disease.

pipeline.title: An AI drug specialist zeroes in on rare forms of obesity
pipeline.summary: Superluminal Medicines banked $60 million in funding to support development of a drug designed to work similarly to — but potentially be more selectively than — Rhythm Pharmaceuticals’ marketed medicine Imcivree.

pipeline.title: GSK wagers up to $1.3B on a different kind of cancer drug
pipeline.summary: With its latest foray into China, GSK acquired rights from Hutchmed to an “antibody-targeted therapy conjugate” impacting two well-known cancer drivers, EGFR and KRAS.

pipeline.title: Psilocybin proves promising in neuropathic pain mouse study
pipeline.summary: Amid the rise of psychedelics in the mental health space, researchers have begun to explore psilocybin as a treatment for chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy.

pipeline.title: Pfizer offloads scrapped Seagen ADC to Medicus Pharma in up to $1B+ deal
pipeline.summary: Pfizer has found a new home for an antibody-drug conjugate it acquired in its $43 billion Seagen buyout and dropped earlier this year.

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx to weigh ‘significant’ cost cuts as Angelman drug fails key study
pipeline.summary: The failure of what was once considered a potential blockbuster therapy represents a major setback in a tough-to-treat disease and is forcing Ultragenyx to closely examine its expenses.

pipeline.title: FDA files reveal lingering concerns, contrasting views behind Replimune melanoma nod
pipeline.summary: Two votes of confidence from leaders at the FDA’s Office of Clinical Evaluation and the Oncology Center of Excellence sealed Replimune’s fate, overruling review staffers’ concerns and paving the way for last month’s accelerated nod for Tudriqev.

pipeline.title: Akeso, Summit’s ivonescimab extends lives in Keytruda head-to-head trial. What now?
pipeline.summary: About two years ago, a head-to-head progression-free survival win made Akeso and Summit’s ivonescimab—and the PD-1xVEGF class—the most promising agent to replace Keytruda. Now, that same trial has met its overall survival endpoint, but to a far more measured reception.

pipeline.title: Akeso, Summit cancer drug confirms lung cancer survival benefit
pipeline.summary: A new data cut of a trial pitting ivonescimab, a bispecific antibody, against Merck’s Keytruda showed the new drug helped people live longer.

pipeline.title: The hidden scale-out problem behind CAR-T’s growth
pipeline.summary: CAR-T’s commercial challenge is making thousands of patient-specific manufacturing runs behave like one reliable system. "In vivo" production techniques could be one solution.

pipeline.title: GSK pens $1.3B Hutchmed deal for early-stage KRAS-EGFR cancer asset
pipeline.summary: GSK is handing over $110 million upfront to Hutchmed in a deal worth up to $1.295 billion to get its hands on a first-in-class oncology candidate.

pipeline.title: CMI boosts medical affairs capabilities with new specialty communications unit
pipeline.summary: The new business unit is centered on four core capabilities, which includes AI-enhanced scientific intelligence, omnichannel "scientific ecosystems," and more.

pipeline.title: ARPA-H puts up $125M to bankroll personalized RNA-based drug production
pipeline.summary: RNA-based vaccines and therapeutics may have faced a bumpy road in the U.S. recently, but a major new federal investment proves the government is still betting big on its future.

pipeline.title: Novartis telegraphs 130 job cuts amid biologics rethink in Switzerland
pipeline.summary: Novartis could cut about 130 jobs in Switzerland as it rethinks its biologics technical development and production footprint in Basel.

pipeline.title: ESC: Amgen CMO flags Repatha 'inflection' amid new data on mortality benefit
pipeline.summary: On the back of a heart-helping win for the 11-year-old Repatha last fall, Amgen has continued to deepen the evidence on its PCSK9 inhibitor’s ability to cut cardiovascular risks in many patients.

pipeline.title: Autoimmune CAR-T faces tough questions after Novartis, Bristol Myers study halts
pipeline.summary: Wall Street analysts believe that a more cautious approach to manufacturing, study enrollment and side effect management could help developers avoid future safety hazards.

pipeline.title: Teva autoimmune antibody notches ph. 2 win in celiac disease
pipeline.summary: Teva Pharmaceutical's dreams of a first-in-class autoimmune blockbuster are being kept alive after the Israeli outfit’s anti-interleukin-15 antibody scored a midstage win in celiac disease.

pipeline.title: SEC, FDA sign info-sharing agreement as a ‘signal to the market’ on insider trading
pipeline.summary: The SEC and the FDA have signed a three-year agreement to step up cooperation and information-sharing capabilities, aiming to improve each organization’s regulatory and enforcement missions.

pipeline.title: TScan axes 75% of workforce to make room for solid tumor programs
pipeline.summary: TCR-T specialist TScan Therapeutics will reduce its workforce by 75% following the pause of its hematological and autoimmune programs.

pipeline.title: Trump GLP-1 update teases blockbuster annual sales for Lilly from Medicare program: analyst
pipeline.summary: As part of the MFN drug pricing deal the Trump administration signed with obesity giants Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk, Medicare recently launched a “bridge” model, offering weight loss drugs to eligible seniors at $50 per month. Now, we know the initial uptake from the program.

pipeline.title: Cellares downsizes New Jersey operations after losing BMS cell therapy contract
pipeline.summary: After losing Bristol Myers Squibb as a client, Cellares continues to move forward with the right-sizing its CEO unveiled late last month.

pipeline.title: Novartis inks $3.2B subcutaneous drug delivery deal with Alteogen
pipeline.summary: Novartis has struck a deal worth up to $3.2 billion to work with Alteogen on subcutaneous drug delivery, joining Biogen and GSK on the list of drugmakers to pay to access the technology this year.

pipeline.title: From his parents’ basement to your medicine cabinet: Absci CEO endeavors to create biotech’s Apple
pipeline.summary: The overwhelming demand for GLP-1 weight loss drugs has reshaped the drug market, empowering consumers to take charge of their own health and removing barriers between their wallets and their medicine cabinets.

pipeline.title: Galderma, Novartis dominated ad space last NFL season with most effective ads: report
pipeline.summary: TV outcomes company EDO determined that Galderma’s skin disease med Nemluvio led the charge with the highest engagement score across all advertisers during the 2025-26 NFL football season.

pipeline.title: Rising Stars: Genentech’s Tiffany William brings a 'fail fast, learn fast' marketing mentality
pipeline.summary: After pivoting from mobile gaming marketing to pharma, Genentech performance marketing engagement lead Tiffany William is making performance marketing "less daunting" and "more fun" and approachable.

pipeline.title: Roche inks $1.53B deal for Simcere’s B-cell-targeting antibody
pipeline.summary: Roche is paying oncology-focused Simcere Zaiming $75 million upfront for global rights to a preclinical trispecific antibody targeting B-cell-mediated diseases.

pipeline.title: ArsenalBio sheds most of staff in pivot to in vivo CAR-T
pipeline.summary: About a year after halving its staff in a clinical push, Arsenal Biosciences is now making a hard pivot that involves laying off most of its employees and seeking out new homes for its assets.

pipeline.title: Bausch + Lomb survey reveals low dry eye awareness for perimenopausal, postmenopausal women
pipeline.summary: A new survey out from Bausch + Lomb has shown that dry eye disease is one of the least recognized symptoms present in perimenopausal and postmenopausal women.

pipeline.summary: Medtronic is recalling certain esophageal pH monitoring capsule delivery devices amid risks of them failing whilst deployed.
